results.text: Please note that the Group is required to amend the bylaws by January 1, 2027 following publication of the Order of October 15, 2024 and Decree No. 2025-744 of July 30, 2025, on transposing the Women on Board directive, on gender balance within the Supervisory Board, in particular with regard to employee representation on the Supervisory Board. A resolution amending the bylaws will be submitted to the next combined general shareholders' meeting on May 21, 2026.
